messages:
Maria Chen: FYI — launching an opt-in internal preview of Ensemble Adaptive Serving (ensemble-adaptive-v1). Preview keys active now, limited GA in us-west-2 + eu-west-1 next Wednesday. Docs: https://go/redwood/ensemble-preview :sparkles:

Alex Ruiz: Sweet. How is this surfaced? new route or model name?

Maria Chen: It's a model family you can call with the existing /v1/generate. No API surface change. Example payload:
```
{
  "model": "ensemble-adaptive-v1",
  "prompt": "Translate to French: 'Launch schedule'",
  "routing": {"latency_target_ms": 120}
}
```

Sam O'Neill: Streaming + tool-calling compatibility?

Maria Chen: Streaming supported. We stitch partial streams from members. Tool-calls preserved but ordering can hop if latency_target_ms is low — bump that to 300ms for deterministic tool sequencing.

Jess Patel: Any special quotas or billing for preview?

Evan Li: Preview keys are limited to 2rps/org by default. Costs measured as weighted per-member token use; publishing ballpark per-token multiplier in billing doc before GA.

Alex Ruiz: Will Console show per-member traces / cost split?

Maria Chen: Yes — Console will surface per-member latency, cost, and an aggregate 'consensus quality' metric. Retention 30d for preview telemetry.

ops-bot: Canary window posted — us-west-2 2026-06-09T01:00Z -> progressive ramp to 25% over 90m. Pager if 5xx rate >0.8% for 10m.

deploy-bot: deploy 2172501234: ensemble-runtime v1.0.0 deployed to canary by @infra-team — https://go/redwood/deploy/2172501234

Maria Chen: Known limitations: (1) KV-prefix cache may not be identical across members — pin a model for strong consistency. (2) Quantized members may have slightly different tokenization on fringe unicode.

Sam O'Neill: Where to drop regression prompts?

Jess Patel: Upload eval sets to gs://ai-evals/ensemble-preview and tag ensemble-preview-2172. We'll wire them into nightly regressions.

Maria Chen: TL;DR: opt-in internal preview available now; GA next week in two regions; same /v1/generate, model name ensemble-adaptive-v1; separate preview quota, Console per-member metrics. Try it & file feedback on the doc. :rocket:

Alex Ruiz: Trying now, will share quick perf notes.

Evan Li: If you hit anomalies include trace IDs from Console and ping #eng-runtime.

Maria Chen: Thanks! I'll follow up with SDK helper notes and billing estimate later today.
